name: Hitozuma Onna Kyoushi Seiyoku no Kyoushitsu 3
original_name: 人妻女教師 性欲の教室 ３
source:
---This sort of thing isn't allowed at school!---

His father was Shuichiro Ayukawa, president of The Ayukawa Group, who had in a single generation wiped out the competition.
His mother, Satomi Ayukawa, was the feared and merciless headmistress of the school he attended.

With such formidable parents, average protagonist Hideaki Ayukawa didn't live life so much as was shoved along its narrow path...

Hideaki's sole relief from the stress was the homeroom teacher for whom he longed, Ms. Keiko Sawaguchi, and his friendship with her son Ayumu, until...

Amid those days, Ms. Keiko asked Hideaki to discuss something in private.
In an empty classroom, to the protagonist whose chest
was tight with desire and anticipation, she imparted words...
The slow grind of gears, the blood of the rising Ayukawa family.
A overflowing thirst for ripeness originated from within drags Hideaki into a world of perversion. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE137594.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
——這種事在學校是不允許的！——

他的父親鯰川修一郎是鯰川集團的社長，僅用一代人就消滅了競爭對手。
他的母親鯰川里美，是他就讀學校中令人畏懼、毫不留情的女校長。

在如此強勢的父母影響下，普通的主角鯰川英明與其說是在生活，不如說是在狹窄道路上被推著前進……

英明唯一的慰藉，是自己愛慕的導師澤口慶子，以及與她兒子步的友誼，直到……

在那段日子裡，慶子老師請英明私下談話。
在一間空教室裡，她向胸中充滿慾望與期待的主角說出了某些話……
齒輪緩慢轉動，崛起的鯰川家族血脈流淌。
一股源自內心、滿溢而出的成熟渴望，把英明拖入了墮落世界。
